note: Pure-CLI tool (no server/daemon), so the factory's live-auth probe is scoped out. The routing table (domains.json) is verified on every rebuild by d01; the 23 unit tests are re-run by d02; the folded front-end's own OS smoke suite (12 tests) is re-run by d03. pytest_target overrides the factory's default 'tests/' because this repo keeps its tests at the root.
